╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

📋 ISSUE
────────
MCP servers in .vscode/mcp.json work in VS Code but don't load in Copilot Coding Agent

🔍 ROOT CAUSE  
─────────────
VS Code:              .vscode/mcp.json (workspace file) ✅
Copilot Coding Agent: Repository Settings on GitHub.com ❌ Not configured

Different configuration locations and formats

✅ CORRECT SOLUTION (Repository Administrators)
────────────────────────────────────────────────
1. Go to repository Settings on GitHub.com
2. Navigate to Copilot → Coding agent  
3. Add MCP configuration JSON in settings
4. Click Save

⚡ MCP CONFIGURATION JSON
──────────────────────────
Paste this into repository settings:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "sequential-thinking": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking"],
      "tools": ["*"]
    },
    "context7": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp"],
      "tools": ["*"]
    },
    "memory": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"],
      "tools": ["*"]
    },
    "serena": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": [
        "--from",
        "git+https://github.com/oraios/serena",
        "serena",
        "start-mcp-server",
        "--context",
        "ide-assistant",
        "--enable-web-dashboard",
        "False",
        "--project",
        "${workspaceFolder}"
      ],
      "tools": ["*"]
    }
  }
}

🔑 KEY FORMAT DIFFERENCES
──────────────────────────
VS Code (.vscode/mcp.json):
  • "servers": { ... }
  • "type": "stdio"
  
Copilot Coding Agent (Repository Settings):
  • "mcpServers": { ... }
  • "type": "local"
  • "tools": [...] (required)
